root_cause.text: In `f2fs_do_zero_range()` the error path could call `f2fs_update_read_extent_cache_range()` and `f2fs_update_age_extent_cache_range()` with `index == start`, creating a zero-length extent in F2FS’s extent cache, which later tripped the `extent len is zero` BUG in `__update_extent_tree_range()`.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `if (index > start)` around the two extent-cache अपडेट calls in `fs/f2fs/file.c`, and the CVE description explicitly says “In error path of f2fs_zero_range(), it may add a zero-sized extent into extent cache,” with the crash occurring in `__update_extent_tree_range` reporting `extent len is zero`.

intent_record.intent_summary: Add a bounds check so extent cache updates run only when the affected range is non-empty.
intent_record.what: The two calls that update the read extent cache and age extent cache were moved inside a new conditional block, so they now execute only when `index > start`; the arguments to those calls remain unchanged.
intent_record.how: This prevents the cache-update routines from being invoked with a zero or negative range length when the zero-range operation does not advance past `start`, avoiding unnecessary or potentially invalid extent cache updates.

grouping_result.intent: Add a bounds check so extent cache updates run only when the affected range is non-empty.

relevance_review.reason: The change directly matches the root cause: it adds a bounds check to prevent extent cache update helpers from being called on an empty range, avoiding the zero-length extent that triggered the BUG.

candidates.rationale: This pre-fix call unconditionally updates the read extent cache even when index == start, so the computed length becomes zero and can create a zero-length extent.
This pre-fix call unconditionally updates the age extent cache with length index - start, which becomes zero when index == start and triggers the invalid zero-length extent condition.

vuln_statements.explanation: This unconditional extent-cache update can be reached with index == start in the error path of f2fs_do_zero_range(), making the computed extent length zero and leading to the invalid zero-length extent in the read extent cache.
This unconditional extent-cache update can also run when index == start, passing a zero length into the age extent cache and triggering the zero-length extent BUG in __update_extent_tree_range().
